brief_title: Transcriptional profiling of yellow fever vaccine-naive participants before and after vaccination against yellow fever.
brief_description: Yellow fever-naive adults were vaccinated with YF-17D (Stamaril). Transcriptomic profiling of blood collected pre-vaccination and post-vaccination at days 3, 7, 14 and 84 was performed.
description: Post-vaccination transcriptomic profiling at days 3, 7, 14 and 84 and other immune parameters were investigated in association with the immune response at day 80 following YF-17D vaccination.
endpoints: Correlation of patterns of cellular and gene expression with antibody levels measured after vaccination.
hypothesis: Identify cellular and transcriptional responses that correlate with different antibody responses to vaccination.
intervention_agent: yellow fever vaccine YF-17D vaccine Stamaril
